entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Player Companion: Martial Arts Handbook
entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your brutal maneuvers shock any who would dare to stand against you.

Prerequisite(s): Dazzling Display, Improved Grapple, Improved Unarmed Strike, Savage Slam, Weapon Focus, base attack bonus +9 or monk level 6th.

Benefit(s): While you are using Savage Slam, if you succeed at your grapple combat maneuver check to knock the opponent prone, you can spend a swift action to attempt an Intimidate check to demoralize foes within 30 feet who could see your attack.
